notes.title: Plankton Offers Up A Tiny Monochrome Electro-pet
notes.content: Plankton [Steam page] is a kind of electronic pet I’ve spent the morning caring for while working this morning. It’s actually the work of GuoJun Pan who I posted about earlier because I was looking into a different game (Flower Design). Rather than folding this into the same post I wanted to give it a moment in the spotlight of its own because it’s so charming – a monochrome maths aquarium whose dots and curves and watery bloop-bloops have been truly soothing. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: I will keep on updating frequently, adding new content.
notes.content:
I will keep on updating frequently, and I need your suggestions so that we can figure out what we really want.
Artworks are independent the moment that author releases it. So other people may get a better understanding about it. 
What it is, what it should be? we could find it together!

                                                                                      Thank you very much!
